question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：阿尔及利亚 vs 奥地利（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Algeria vs Austria — 90-minute three-way result?
one_liner_cn: 奥地利凭 Elo 优势小幅领跑，但 Baumgartner 伤退削弱进攻，刚客胜荷兰的阿尔及利亚状态正佳，三路均无把握。
one_liner_en: Austria edge it on Elo, but Baumgartner's injury blunts their attack while Algeria arrive off an away win over the Netherlands — no outcome is near certain.

key_reasons.cn: 奥地利核心攻击手 Baumgartner（赛季 13 个德甲进球）因伤无缘世界杯，进攻端明显减弱。
key_reasons.en: Austria's in-form attacker Baumgartner (13 Bundesliga goals) is ruled out of the World Cup by injury, a clear blow to their attack.

key_reasons.cn: 阿尔及利亚 6 月 3 日客场 1-0 击败荷兰，赛前状态出色；但中场 Boudaoui 伤缺、Bennacer 落选。
key_reasons.en: Algeria beat the Netherlands 1-0 away on Jun 3 — strong form — though Boudaoui is injured and Bennacer was omitted.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 58 分（奥地利 1830 vs 阿尔及利亚 1772），中立场地下统计模型给奥地利约 43% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 58-point Elo gap (Austria 1830 vs Algeria 1772) on a neutral venue gives Austria a ~43% baseline win probability in the statistical model.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 31.0/25.7/43.3; bounded evidence adjustment of 4pp total (Algeria +1.5, Draw +0.5, Austria -2.0) for Baumgartner's absence vs Algeria's own midfield losses; renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 and ~±40 Elo sensitivity. No betting or prediction-market data used.
